title: Canadian Beef Wrap
description: A hearty Canadian-inspired beef wrap with roasted vegetables and a tangy sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the shredded cabbage, sliced carrots, and red onion with 1 tablespoon of oil and a pinch of salt.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, cook the beef strips over medium-high heat until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly.
Warm the Canadian wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a dollop of sour cream on each wrap, followed by a few slices of beef, some roasted vegetables, and a sprinkle of parsley.
Cook's note: You can also add some shredded cheddar cheese or chopped bacon to the wraps for extra flavor.
